allowed_scope.purpose: Enable provider-backed Cline AgentRuntime continuation behind the already-proven governed Node stdio boundary while preserving Python/LBE authorization, tool execution, receipt, evidence, validation, completion, and session authority.
allowed_scope.implementation_changes: Cline worker provider construction, proxy-tool proposal/result handoff, Python mediation through GovernedToolOrchestrator, cancellation mapping, focused tests, and acceptance checkpoint only; no MCP, TUI, ClineCore, provider-selection UI, retry redesign, or release work
allowed_actions: accept ephemeral provider configuration at runtime.start without persisting or echoing credentials
construct pinned @cline/agents AgentRuntime and use its existing run/continue loop
expose only explicit LBE allowed_tools as proxy AgentTools
emit deterministic tool.proposed correlation frames and await matching tool.result frames
route proposals through existing Python GovernedToolOrchestrator.invoke and ToolReceipt
map terminal Cline run result to turn.completed or turn.failed without claiming LBE completion truth
add focused deterministic continuation and governed tool handoff tests
run live provider proof when configuration is available and classify missing credentials as BLOCKED_CONFIGURATION
